title: A product review is running code on the reviews page
brief: Someone left a review on the kettle listing and now every visitor to that page gets a popup. The review text is being dropped straight into the page as markup.

functionalSuite.label: A review containing an angle bracket

hints: The attack did not need a <script> tag. Filtering for one would miss both payloads above.
The problem is that the browser is being asked to parse this text as markup at all. What if it were never parsed?
Set body.textContent instead of body.innerHTML. Text is displayed, never executed.
